lines: Ada: Roses? Fine. Forty years ago they drowned my quarter.
Ada: A reservoir for the Houses. Nobody redrew the streets.
Ada: Water nobody maps grows thin. Then it tears.
Ada: The Lock Rift opened that winter. Under my street.
Ada: The families moved away. Their Spirlings stayed.
Ada: Hear that dull ring under the water? That's them.
Ada: We call it the Tarnish. It is only calling.
Ada: So I chalk the streets back. One rose a night.
Ada: But my survey book was sold. It's at the opera now.
Ada: My book. Look: the water stairs, the old bakery.
Ada: With this I can draw it all again. Every street.
Ada: The last line belongs at the great lamp of Lastlamp.
Ada: Once the vault under it is mended. Not before.

ada_wait: Ada: The opera on Larkspur Heights. Ask the prompter.

lines: Ada: The vault is mended. Now, the last street.
Ada draws one thin line: the water stair, up to the lamp.
Under the canal the dull ringing stops. It listens.
Ada: Hum the Echo melody, {name}. They still know it.
One by one the left-behind calls go soft. Then still.
Ada: Not gone. Heard. That was all they wanted.
Ada: The Old Quarter is on the map again. Thank you.

lamp_after: Ada: Nico chalks the roses now. His are crooked.

lines: Ada: The vault first. Then we draw the last line.
Merrit: A survey book? Ah. My cue book.
Merrit: I cut masks from its pages. Streets make fine eyes.
Merrit: I didn't know they were anyone's streets.
Merrit: Still, a prompter gives nothing without a scene.
Merrit: Win, and the book goes home.

merrit_after: Merrit: Tell Ada the masks are back in their box.
merrit_defeat: Merrit: Bravo. Take it. Most pages are still there.
Merrit: Tell Ada I'm sorry. I'll come and say it myself.
merrit_lose: Merrit: Curtain. Try again after the interval.

lines: Merrit: Rehearsal. Come back once the locks are quiet.
Nico: Every morning there's a chalk rose on the lock gate.
Nico: A compass rose. Like on the old guild maps.
Nico: Gran says it's nothing. Gran lies badly.
Nico: Ada Quarle. Tallowmarket. Ask her, not me.

nico_after: Nico: Gran's at the Tallowmarket. Mind her temper.
